decision: 12 CWAs in path-of-construction order; one CWP per CWA and discipline (level-3 activity with the same id); one EWP per CWP, needed ewp_lead_days (default 20 wd) before the CWP starts; MRs are the PWPs, needed on site at the earliest start of their CWPs; IWPs by the construction contractors. A CWP is released only when its EWP is complete (IFC) and its PWP materials are on site or confirmed in time.
rationale: Owner AWP requirement; accepted in TQ-035.
title: Advanced Work Packaging: CWA / CWP / EWP / PWP / IWP definitions and release rules
